name: sniper_rifle
notes: One shot, four hundred metres, no falloff, and twice the damage in the top of a body: a head shot kills outright and anything else leaves a man who has to go and find a health pack. The right button is the sight rather than a second mode -- it narrows the view to a third and does not fire, so nobody loses a round into the floor reaching for it. Five in the magazine and two and a bit seconds to fill it, which is the whole of its weakness: miss twice in a corridor and whoever you missed is on top of you.
